utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the target spot for the repair drive—once you confirm it, I’ll note it down right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’m still confirming the target spot, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — just send it over when it’s confirmed, and I’ll note the location right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate any updates as the repair drive details come together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the time and supplies sorted, and I’ll keep spreading the word in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep checking in while the details get sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m keeping track of the supplies, and I’ll let you know if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Cleo — just let me know if anything else comes up, and I’ll bring the gloves and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got gloves and flashlight down, and I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m still checking the time, but I’ll let you know soon. I can bring the duct tape, Phillips screwdriver, and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the time before sharing anything. If you get the full details, please send them along so I can confirm the list too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’m still on it, and I’ll send the time and the full details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — just let me know the repair drive time when you have it, and I’ll work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — appreciate it. Just send me the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll plan around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still haven’t heard a firm time yet, Uli, but I’m keeping an eye out and can help as soon as they set it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate you keeping watch — as soon as they confirm the time, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Uli — I’ll be ready to jump in as soon as you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I’m still keeping an ear out on the repair drive—have you heard any timing update yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the next timing update. If you hear anything, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands, so I’ll check back in soon if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got my list ready, and I’ll drop the items off this afternoon. Keeps it simple and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Eli — I’ll keep repeating that plan so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you keeping it straight — I’ll swing by this afternoon and that should do it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Sam — if you can bring any tools or spare parts, that’d be a huge help. We’ve already got a nice little crowd, so you’d be right on time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll bring the tools and see if I have any spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If pickup still works, that’d be easiest for me — I’m free after 5, but I’d like to confirm the exact address and timing too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the address and timing first. If anything changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the timing and address.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — I’m sorting the tools now and could use a hand loading them up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help load the tools up and keep an eye out for anything else that needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the details so you can jump in where you’re most useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the details and I’ll bring what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll send the list over today, and thanks for being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep it simple and drop my things off this afternoon. I’ve got a clear list ready, so it should be easy to manage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Eli — that’ll make it easier. I’m heading over now to help with the tool table and any last-minute fixes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane. I’ll bring my list and stop by this afternoon, and I’ll keep it easy to sort out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — just let me know the time once it’s set, and I’ll work around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the school schedule flexible and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring the drill and a couple extension cords? That’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring the drill and a couple extension cords over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. I’m sorting the tools now and could use a hand loading them up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can help load the tools up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll keep you posted on the time and place, and we’ll get the tools sorted for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — just let me know when and where, and I’ll be there to help load everything up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I want to make sure I have the details right first. What needs repairing, and what’s the plan for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a short list of the biggest fixes, and Rosa is pairing each one with a helper. We’ll go through them in order and see who can take what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, that helps — can you share the list in order, and I’ll note who’s helping with each one?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic — thanks, Cleo! I’ll keep spreading the word, and if anyone can make it, bring them by with a friend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can come and bring a friend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep telling folks around the block, and I’ll let you know if I hear anyone who can bring extra hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can arrange pickup — what’s the exact address, and is after 5 still best for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: After 5 still works for me, and I’d really appreciate pickup. I just need to confirm the exact address so I can make sure I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — send me the exact address when you have it, and I’ll set up pickup for after 5.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep checking while I’m out and circle back as soon as I hear a time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll wait for your update before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear a time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — send me the latest plan and I’ll keep repeating it so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I’ll send you the latest plan with the date, time, and a quick list of useful items and skills so you can keep sharing it around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the date, time, and the useful items and skills so folks stay in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry — I still haven’t nailed down the time yet, but I’ll check and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries at all — just let me know when you’ve got the time, and I’ll pass it along. The repair drive’s already got a nice little buzz, so I’m sure folks will be happy to hear the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll check on the time and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll send over the repair-drive details so you can jump in where it’s most useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — I’ll look over the details and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Rey — I’ll send the details over shortly, and we can coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to note it down as soon as you confirm the target spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’m just waiting on Rosa for the time and place. I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep my notes open and watch for Rosa’s time and place.
